parameters.name: AudioFormat
parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The **DeviceName** of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID. You can call [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~) to obtain this parameter.

> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device, and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: SpeechId
parameters.description:
The unique speech ID sent to the device.
><notice>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates one. If you retry a speech playback for business purposes, specify the speech ID of the retry to avoid duplicate playback.
></notice>

parameters.name: SpeechRate
parameters.description: The speech rate. Valid values: -500 to 500.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text content. This parameter is required when the speech type is set to custom. The text supports English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length is 1 to 100 characters. A Chinese character occupies two characters.

parameters.name: Voice
parameters.description: The voice for speech playback, which is preset by the system, such as standard female voice or standard male voice. You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the Value in VoiceList from the response parameters.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100.
